question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP tools/list request (jsonrpc 2.0, id 1, empty params) sent as its own request to the shopping endpoint the merchant's discovery document names: no credential, no HTTP signature, no cookie jar, no Mcp-Session-Id header, and no initialize on this connection; section (R2) of the artifact, sent 06:13:27Z

decoded.tools: 13, counted by occurrences of inputSchema over the whole 179,717-byte response (shown up to 2,500 bytes in the artifact, names counted whole): cancel_cart, cancel_checkout, complete_checkout, create_cart, create_checkout, get_cart, get_checkout, get_order, get_product, lookup_catalog, search_catalog, update_cart, update_checkout: the same thirteen as on 2026-09-20 and as the merchant tools/list of 2026-09-29 (section 4 of evidence/shopify-ucp/2026-09-29/probes-0621Z.txt, p-20260929-shopify-ucp-profile-gate).
decoded.statelessness: the endpoint answered a tools/list that followed no initialize on this connection and issued no session id header; no www-authenticate header on this response, or on any response of the pass.
decoded.why-re-sent: Re-sent 2026-10-10 because the record of this request from 2026-09-20 (p-20260920-shopify-ucp-checkout-anonymous) was filed before this prober kept transcripts, names no artifact, and filed four requests as one record. The 2026-09-29 merchant tools/list already has a transcript; this one is here because the September pass is re-sent whole and each of its requests gets its own record. The four requests of that record, re-sent as one pass from its own reproducibility.command 06:13:26Z to 06:13:29Z, are appendix (R) of the artifact and four records, one per request: p-20261010-shopify-ucp-well-known-discovery (R1), p-20261010-shopify-ucp-tools-list-keyless (R2), p-20261010-shopify-ucp-checkout-anonymous (R3), p-20261010-shopify-ucp-get-order-anonymous (R4). Nothing measured here changed since 2026-09-20.
decoded.not-measured: whether a credentialed caller is listed more or different tools; what the thirteen tool descriptions say about authentication (the response was counted, not read, beyond the names). The set-cookie value on this response is redacted in the artifact as a session cookie; nothing here depends on it.

finding: A bare tools/list with no credential and no preceding handshake on one merchant's UCP shopping endpoint answers 200 and lists the same thirteen tools it listed on 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-29: four cart tools, five checkout tools, get_order, get_product, lookup_catalog and search_catalog. Listing is not the gate: which of the thirteen an anonymous caller may invoke is measured by the tools/call records (two refused by name, get_order and complete_checkout, on 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-29; create_checkout passed through to merchandise validation on 2026-09-20 and again in this pass). No www-authenticate header accompanies the 200, so an anonymous client learns nothing about how to authenticate from the list itself; the refusal on a gated tool is where the vendor's authentication page is named. The surface is unchanged in twenty days; this record exists so that the request has a transcript.
